guard_note: Ablation arm P30 (Execution Plan v2 docs/execution_plan_hpa_predictor_v2.md, Phase 3). IDENTICAL to ablation_guarded_margin110_model.json (arm G30) in every field EXCEPT forecast_source: 'ridge' -> 'persistence'. The feature_names/intercept/coefficients/feature_mean/feature_scale block below is copied byte-for-byte from G30's model so a config mistake that accidentally leaves forecast_source unset falls back to G30's exact Ridge behaviour rather than an undefined one -- but with forecast_source='persistence' set, predictive_engine._forecast_total_rps() bypasses these Ridge fields entirely and uses the last observed total_rps instead. capacity_rps_per_pod / scale_margin / all guard knobs / scale_down_lat95_guard_ms are unchanged from G30 so only the forecast source differs (see agent/tests/test_ablation_invariants.py::test_inv11_g30_vs_p30_only_forecast_source).
